alphaTab offline practice resources

alphaTab 1.8.4 is used unmodified from Maven Central (net.alphatab:alphaTab:1.8.4).
Its source code is available at https://github.com/CoderLine/alphaTab/tree/v1.8.4
under the Mozilla Public License 2.0; the full license is included here.

The dependency AAR bundles Bravura.otf and sonivox.sf2/sonivox.sf3.
Bravura: Steinberg Media Technologies GmbH, SIL Open Font License 1.1.
https://github.com/steinbergmedia/bravura
Sonivox: Copyright (c) 2004-2006 Sonic Network Inc., Apache License 2.0.
https://github.com/CoderLine/alphaTab/tree/v1.8.4/packages/alphatab/font/sonivox
The original Sonivox notice and Apache 2.0 license are included here.

alphaSkia 3.4.135: BSD 3-Clause, with Skia and other third-party notices.
https://github.com/CoderLine/alphaSkia
The upstream combined license and notices are included here.

These components are installed with the App. No runtime resource download is used.
The release APK contains no private desktop GP fixtures. Imported files remain local.
